## Ajwadi Dashboard – Specification Icons

**This document lists all specification icon values sent to the backend and the raw SVGs used in the frontend.**

### How icons are sent to the backend

- In forms, the icon is represented only by a **string value** (e.g. `programming`, `video-editing`, `customer-support`).
- The hidden input in `IconSelectDropdown` sends that value:

```startLine:endLine:src/components/forms/IconSelectDropdown.tsx
<input
  type="hidden"
  name={name}
  id={id}
  value={value}
  readOnly
/>
```

Use these values in your backend models / DTOs as the `icon` field (or equivalent).
